en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street with cobblestones and a few pedestrians. On the right stands a prominent neoclassical building with columns and a pediment, likely a church or public hall, partly obscured by large trees. A small monument or obelisk stands in the tree‑filled square in front of it. Low wooden houses line the street to the left, and forested hills are visible in the distance. The word "Hamina." is printed in white in the lower right corner of the image.
